en.askTitle: Put in your own dates, passports and food rules to get the same visa, rail-pass and meal-by-meal check
en.runTitle: A vegetarian family of four from Mumbai: 14 days in Japan, 2–15 April 2027, INR 9 lakh

fields.label: Arrival and departure dates and airports
Passports, home city and children’s ages
fields.value: A family of four with Indian passports, living in Mumbai: two parents in their 40s and children aged 9 and 13

fields.label: Food requirements
fields.value: Vegetarian food, with no meat or fish stock

fields.label: Four-person room quotes
fields.placeholder: e.g. a family room for four in Kyoto at ¥38,000 a night

fields.label: Ground budget and exchange-rate assumption
fields.value: A budget of INR 9 lakh for everything except international flights

fields.label: Hiroshima: yes or no
fields.value: whether to include Hiroshima (possible, not decided)

en.template: Plan our Japan trip for {dates} for {profile}, with {diet}. Keep Tokyo–Hakone–Kyoto–Osaka gentle, compare {rooms} against {budget}, and test {hiroshima} before choosing rail tickets. Show open visa/food checks, meal backups, cancellation terms and a contingency-inclusive total. Ask before booking, contacting anyone or submitting documents.

phases.title: Read the official visa, rail pass, vegetarian food and hotel pages
phases.note: Visa rules, rail passes, restaurant menus and family rooms
phases.judgment: It kept estimates from passing as facts: hotel amounts are labelled planning allowances, not quotes; one hotel’s child age cut-off is six, so rail child pricing is not applied to rooms; and a Hiroshima restaurant with contradictory opening hours is flagged to recheck.

phases.title: Cost the route, passes and budget, then write the guide and its source list
phases.note: Rail comparison, day-by-day route and full budget in yen and rupees
phases.judgment: It did the child-fare sums exactly rather than by halving: Odawara–Kyoto is ¥12,100 adult and ¥6,040 child, not ¥6,050. It also refused to assume two discounted Sanyo single tickets would be valid for a same-day return.

phases.title: Independent check of the arithmetic and claims, then desktop and phone layout tests
phases.judgment: The delivery says plainly that this is qualified research: the arithmetic passes, but local fares, 2027 prices and hotel rates, visa appointments and proof that every page was read in a fresh, signed-out browser are still open, and the check lists them rather than hiding them.

workers: Checked the restaurants’ own pages for vegetarian menus and stock in six destinations, and four-person family hotel rooms
Went through the Mumbai consulate and visa-centre checklists and Japan’s foreign ministry rules for the family’s visas
Checked official prices and conditions for the nationwide rail pass, regional passes and the Hakone pass, including child fares and the October 2026 price change
Independent audit: recomputed every money figure and checked the guide’s claims against the source list

zh.askTitle: 填入你自己的日期、护照和饮食要求，就能得到同样的签证、铁路票和逐餐核对
zh.runTitle: 孟买的素食四口之家：2027 年 4 月 2–15 日游日本 14 天，预算 90 万卢比

fields.label: 抵离日本的日期和机场
护照、居住地和孩子年龄
fields.value: 一家四口，持印度护照，住在孟买：父母都四十多岁，孩子 9 岁和 13 岁

fields.label: 饮食要求
fields.value: 素食，汤底也不能有肉或鱼

fields.label: 四人房报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：京都四人家庭房每晚 3.8 万日元

fields.label: 地面预算及汇率假设
fields.value: 除国际机票外，总预算 90 万卢比

fields.label: 是否去广岛
fields.value: 要不要去广岛（有可能去，还没定）

zh.template: 为我们安排{dates}的旅行，成员资料是{profile}，饮食要求是{diet}。东京—箱根—京都—大阪保持轻松，把{rooms}与{budget}对照，先决定{hiroshima}再比较车票。列出签证/饮食待确认项、整餐后备、取消条件和含备用金总额。订房、联系他人或提交文件前先问我。

phases.title: 阅读官方签证、铁路通票、素食餐厅和酒店页面
phases.note: 签证规则、铁路通票、餐厅菜单和家庭房
phases.judgment: 它没有让估算冒充事实：酒店金额标为规划预留而非报价；一家酒店的儿童年龄界线是六岁，所以铁路的儿童票价没有套到住宿上；广岛一家营业时间前后矛盾的餐厅被标出，提醒重新确认。

phases.title: 核算路线、通票和预算，写出指南和来源清单
phases.note: 铁路比价、逐日路线和日元卢比两套全程预算
phases.judgment: 儿童票价它是精确算的，不是简单对半：小田原—京都成人 ¥12,100、儿童 ¥6,040，而不是 ¥6,050。两张打折的山阳新干线单程票，它也没有想当然地当成当天往返可用。

phases.title: 独立核对算术和说法，再测试电脑和手机版面
phases.judgment: 交付时明确说这是“有保留的调研”：算术全部通过，但当地交通票价、2027 年的价格和酒店房价、签证预约，以及全程干净浏览环境的记录仍有待确认，独立核对把它们列了出来，没有藏起来。

workers: 查了六个目的地餐厅自家页面上的素食菜单和汤底，还有四人家庭房的酒店
读了孟买领事馆和签证中心的材料清单，以及日本外务省对这家人签证的规定
查了全国铁路通票、地区通票和箱根通票的官方价格与条件，包括儿童票价和 2026 年 10 月的调价
独立审查：把每个金额重新算一遍，并对照来源清单核对指南里的说法
